## What it is

Boîtier d'angle pour goulotte : carré 40×40 hors-tout, fond 1.6 mm, murs N/E/S. À l'ouest, une rampe de 1.6 mm d'épaisseur à 45° (`portee_angle` = 20.5 mm en X et en Z), vide en dessous. Les murs N/S suivent cette pente. Trou Ø16.4 à 15 mm de l'est et 20 mm du nord (centré en Y). Un pilier aimant pour le couvercle, centré en Y, à l'ouest du trou.

## Design notes

Origin at the west tip of the ramp. Outer height = `epaisseur_paroi + portee_angle` (22.1 mm). N/S wall profiles use the same 45° underside west of the join; rim stays flat at `hauteur`. East wall on the box only.

**The ramp is `epaisseur_paroi` thick measured square to its own 45° plane.** It used to be offset vertically by `epaisseur_paroi`, which is only 1.13 mm of real plate for a 1.6 mm parameter, and that is what fired `min_wall 0.44` on the 64 mm2 west tip face. The perpendicular offset is `epaisseur_paroi * sqrt(2)` = 2.26 mm in Z, so the 45° underside reaches the bed at `hauteur - 2.26` = 19.84, i.e. 0.66 mm west of the floor edge; the ramp foot is clipped flat on the bed over those 0.66 mm and fuses into the floor. `hauteur` therefore does not move (22.10) and the lid is untouched, and the interior surface stays continuous across the join with no step.

No chassis magnets. Lid fixation is one through-bed pillar west of the hole on the Y centreline, with a 0.6 mm cap at the rim (`puit_diametre_canal`).

`min_wall = 0.6` is intentional for the pillar caps.

**Ø16 hole and M16 nut.** The sheet cutout is Ø16. The printed hole is 16.4 mm so it clears the 15.8 mm male (bores print small). A SW22 PA locknut with flats east-west needs 11 mm to the inner east wall plus 0.5 mm free. At `cote_boite` 38 and `trou_depuis_est` 13 that run was 11.4 mm — too tight. The floor grew +2 mm east (`cote_boite` 40, `trou_depuis_est` 15) so the hole's X stays at 45.5 mm and the east run is 13.4 mm. Y recentred at 20. Pillar stays at the ramp join. Nut-flat to pillar is ~1.4 mm.

Floor stays 1.6 mm (see `passe_cable`).

## Don't

- Do not fill under the ramp (no solid corbel, no full-height N/S rectangles under the overhang).
- Do not go back to offsetting the ramp vertically by `epaisseur_paroi`: that is a 1.13 mm plate for a 1.6 mm parameter, and it fires min_wall 0.44 on the west tip.
- Do not add chassis magnet wells in the floor.
- Do not add a west wall; the ramp closes the box.
- Do not drive height and ramp with two independent sliders — keep `portee_angle`.
- Do not thicken the 0.6 mm pillar caps for the default min_wall.
- Do not drop the floor to 1.2 mm to shorten the gland.
- Do not shrink back to 38 mm: the SW22 nut does not fit the old 5 mm east strip.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 0.6
```
